*   Input: A ship specification section (Section 1.1).
    *   Task: Extract explicit, checkable claims.
    *   Output Format: A single valid, parseable JSON object following a specific schema.
    *   Constraints:
        *   No inference of missing values.
        *   No unit conversion.
        *   `quantity` identifies what is measured (width, height, etc.).
        *   `quote` must be verbatim.
        *   Return an empty list if no claims are found.
        *   No extra text, no markdown fences, no comments.
        *   Schema: `{"claims": [{"section_id": "...", "subject": "...", "quantity": "...", "value": "...", "unit": "...", "quote": "..."}]}`.

    *   "The intent of this specification is to describe the concept and the requirements of a innovative small research vessel of aluminium alloy to be operated in the Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea in the coastal and river areas."
        *   Claim: Vessel is made of aluminium alloy. (Is this a checkable claim? Yes, material composition is checkable).
        *   Claim: Vessel is to be operated in Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea. (Operational area).
    *   "The vessel will be built taking into consideration the type of service, and the simplicity of construction and maintenance." (Intent/Guideline, not a specific checkable claim).
    *   "Design, construction, installation, inspection, tests and workmanship details not covered by this specification shall be carried out in accordance to the working and construction drawings and the standard practice of the Builder." (Procedural).
    *   "The reference construction details shall be selected amongst the best construction standards." (Vague).
    *   "Materials, engines, machinery and equipment shall be, generally, in compliance with, the Builder’s standards and with the best practice for this type of vessel and, whenever possible, with European Industrial standards." (General requirement).
    *   "They will comply at least with the under force International Quality Standards (DIN – ISO - European Norms, Wheel marks etc.) and will satisfy the rules and requirements of the attending Classification Society by which they will have been inspected, tested and certified..." (Compliance requirement).
    *   "In case of discrepancies between this Specification and the general arrangement, Specification shall prevail except where otherwise and unequivocally agreed." (Legal/Procedural).
    *   "Any item mentioned more than once... is only to be supplied or carried out once..." (Procedural).
    *   "In consideration of the continuous technical progress... changes... may be proposed, provided that: - they will lead to a weight saving; - they will have at least the same capabilities of the previous ones; - they will result in a remarkable improvement in maintenance and/or installation." (Conditions for change).

    *   *Claim 1:* Material is aluminium alloy.
        *   `section_id`: "1.1"
        *   `subject`: "research vessel"
        *   `quantity`: "material"
        *   `value`: "aluminium alloy"
        *   `unit`: "none" (or empty string, but schema says string)
        *   `quote`: "innovative small research vessel of aluminium alloy"

    *   *Claim 2:* Operational area.
        *   `section_id`: "1.1"
        *   `subject`: "research vessel"
        *   `quantity`: "operational area"
        *   `value`: "Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea in the coastal and river areas"
        *   `unit`: "none"
        *   `quote`: "to be operated in the Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea in the coastal and river areas"

    *   *Claim 3:* Compliance with International Quality Standards.
        *   `section_id`: "1.1"
        *   `subject`: "Materials, engines, machinery and equipment"
        *   `quantity`: "compliance"
        *   `value`: "International Quality Standards (DIN – ISO - European Norms, Wheel marks etc.)"
        *   `unit`: "none"
        *   `quote`: "They will comply at least with the under force International Quality Standards (DIN – ISO - European Norms, Wheel marks etc.)"

    *Refining "Checkable Claims":*
    The prompt asks for "explicit, checkable claims".
    - "aluminium alloy" is a material specification. Checkable.
    - "Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea" is an operational constraint. Checkable.
    - "International Quality Standards" is a compliance requirement. Checkable.

    Let's look at the schema requirements for `value` and `unit`.
    `value` can be string, integer, or number.
    `unit` is a string.

    *Claim 1:*
    `section_id`: "1.1"
    `subject`: "research vessel"
    `quantity`: "material"
    `value`: "aluminium alloy"
    `unit`: ""
    `quote`: "innovative small research vessel of aluminium alloy"
